Model a cantilever beam of length L = 1800 mm, fixed at x = 0 and free at x = L, using Euler-Bernoulli beam theory (small deflection, linear elastic).
Use N-mm-MPa units throughout: P = 2000 N, L = 1800 mm, E = 200000 MPa (i.e. N/mm²), I = 1200000 mm⁴.
The internal bending moment varies linearly as M(x) = P(L − x), equal to PL at the fixed end and zero at the free end.
Compute the slope at the free end using the closed-form expression θ = PL²/(2EI).
Compute the vertical deflection at the free end using the closed-form expression δ = PL³/(3EI).
Report the slope in radians and also in degrees.
Report the deflection in millimetres.
State the assumed direction (downward deflection, clockwise slope) consistent with a downward tip load on a right-hand cantilever.
